resolved_conflicts.explanation: Destroyed on firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts and the Clearwater list; removed on Forest Lookouts. The story reports both and the record keeps gone.

notes_for_editor: Three pages and the Clearwater list agree on the 1934 L-4 tower and the 1960s destruction. The record's 1960 year is a decade placeholder and is corrected. The 1972 staff entry on Idaho Fire Lookouts conflicts with the 1960s destruction; it is kept as an event and flagged in the story. The Clearwater list gives an elevation of 6418 ft; it is not used in the story.
